stages.name: Question
stages.en: Which domino causes the next one to fall?

stages.name: Scene key
stages.en: Four physical dominoes, four fallen-state variables: F1 to F4.

stages.name: Observational skeleton
stages.en: 512 observation images give a chain, but all three directions remain unresolved.

stages.name: Select 1
stages.en: Round 1: select domino 2 to test the remaining directions.

stages.name: Fixed control 1
stages.en: Control: F2 = 0, held upright by a simulator fixture—not a robot grasp.

stages.name: Push setup 1
stages.en: Separate recorded example: an initially upright target is pushed by the gripper.

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The gripper approaches domino 2; the target starts upright.

stages.name: push
stages.en: Gripper contact pushes domino 2; watch the downstream response.

stages.name: retract
stages.en: The gripper withdraws. Read the settled image before updating the graph.

stages.name: Direct evidence
stages.en: The response evidence orients F2 → F3; F1—F2 is still unresolved.

stages.name: Graph-rule propagation
stages.en: Meek propagation adds F3 → F4. It does not settle F1—F2.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Reset for round 2; keep the graph learned in round 1.

stages.name: Select 2
stages.en: Round 2: select domino 1 to test the remaining directions.

stages.name: Fixed control 2
stages.en: Control: F1 = 0, held upright by a simulator fixture—not a robot grasp.

stages.name: Push setup 2
stages.en: Separate recorded example: an initially upright target is pushed by the gripper.

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The gripper approaches domino 1; the target starts upright.

stages.name: push
stages.en: Gripper contact pushes domino 1; watch the downstream response.

stages.name: retract
stages.en: The gripper withdraws. Read the settled image before updating the graph.

stages.name: Update 2
stages.en: The second batch resolves F1 → F2; the previously learned directions remain.

stages.name: Result
stages.en: Two recorded rounds: F1 → F2 → F3 → F4.

scope: Archived four-node graph-discovery run with a frozen visual encoder; no learned calibration, new acquisitions or main-table replacement.
presentation: Recomposited original robot frames; fixed cameras; English-only captions and labels; graph states from discovery logs. Static cards and explicit resets added. Timing follows original replay frame cadence, not a real-time physics claim.
paper_relation: Four-domino rigid-body scene used in the paper; this is an archived robot-contact discovery adaptation, not a rerun of the paper aggregate.
zero_command: Simulator fixture holds upright; not a robot grasp
one_command: Gripper contact pushes the initially upright target
sample_relationship: Displayed controls and pushes are separate example contexts, not paired counterfactual predictions
